**Finding: compliant — no redline proposed.**

The auto-renewal bargain in §13 (p0078) already works in our favour:

| Checklist parameter | Document position | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Renewal term length | "successive one year periods" | Meets preferred (≤12 months) |
| Non-renewal notice window | 30 days, exercisable by Client | Meets preferred (≤30 days); inside ≤60-day fallback |
| Walk-away triggers | No >90-day window, no multi-year renewal | Clear |
| Renewal price increases | No uplift right — fees fixed in Exhibits A/B (p0045), one-year freeze plus MFN (p0047), amendments need our signature (p0081) | Condition not triggered |

Because the clause satisfies both fallback elements on their material terms — and in fact hits three of the five preferred elements — I did not upgrade it. The two preferred-only gaps (no 60-day vendor renewal reminder, no express lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap) are recorded in the rationale as minor sub-elements, consistent with the playbook's instruction that a missing reminder mechanic or price-uplift cap is noted rather than flagged, especially where TrueLink has no unilateral right to reprice on renewal.
